name: planetary_reference_sites
crs_note: NOT WGS84. Coordinates are planetocentric body-fixed lon/lat: Moon features use IAU_2015:30100 (Moon 2015 sphere), Mars features use IAU_2015:49900 (Mars 2015 planetocentric). Do not overlay on Earth basemaps; render on separate Moon/Mars basemaps (e.g., NASA Trek WMTS).

properties.name: Lunar south polar highlands (pole-centred region containing Artemis III candidate regions)
properties.status_note: NASA lists nine Artemis III candidate landing regions near the south pole (Peak near Cabeus B, Haworth, Malapert Massif, Mons Mouton Plateau, Mons Mouton, Nobile Rim 1, Nobile Rim 2, de Gerlache Rim 2, Slater Plain); these are candidate regions, not selected sites and not approved permanent-base locations.
properties.elevation_datum: Moon: height above 1737.4 km sphere; Mars: MOLA areoid
properties.illumination: Peaks along the rim of Shackleton are illuminated about 80–90% of each lunar orbit (literature); PSRs never illuminated
properties.ice_evidence: Cold traps >80° latitude host most water-ice cold-trap area (Hayne et al. 2021 summarised in wiki:Lunar water).
properties.hazards: steep crater walls and massif slopes; long low-angle shadows; extreme thermal gradients between sunlit and shadowed terrain; no atmosphere; radiation; 1/6 g
properties.mission_objectives: crewed landing (Artemis III candidate regions); polar volatiles prospecting; sample of ancient crust; power from near-continuous illumination

properties.name: Shackleton crater and rim vicinity
properties.status_note: Frequently studied south-polar crater; 'Connecting Ridge' near Shackleton appeared on NASA's 2022 list of 13 regions but not on the 2024 refined list of nine (per The Register summary, 2024-10-29). Not an approved base site.
properties.elevation_datum: Moon: height above 1737.4 km sphere; Mars: MOLA areoid
properties.illumination: rim peaks ~80–90% illuminated; interior in perpetual darkness
properties.ice_evidence: LOLA reflectance analysis suggests up to 22% of Shackleton's surface may be covered in ice (wiki:Lunar water; Zuber et al. 2012).
properties.hazards: ~4.2 km deep conical crater with steep walls; permanent shadow in interior; thermal extremes
properties.mission_objectives: PSR volatiles access; illuminated rim for power; ancient crust sampling

properties.name: Malapert massif
properties.status_note: 'Malapert Massif' is one of NASA's nine Artemis III candidate landing regions (NASA news release 2024-10-28).
properties.elevation_datum: Moon: height above 1737.4 km sphere; Mars: MOLA areoid
properties.illumination: two ridge regions illuminated ~74% of the lunar year (Bussey et al. 2010 as cited by Allender et al. 2019)
properties.ice_evidence: Small-scale PSRs in surrounding area (Allender et al. 2019).
properties.hazards: massif rises ~5 km; slopes 15–25° on ridge approaches (Allender et al. 2019)
properties.mission_objectives: Artemis III candidate region; Earth line-of-sight communications; SPA basin rim material

properties.name: Cabeus crater permanently shadowed region (LCROSS impact target)
properties.status_note: Verified LCROSS impact target (2009-10-09); a mission impact site, not a landing or base site.
properties.elevation_datum: Moon: height above 1737.4 km sphere; Mars: MOLA areoid
properties.illumination: main crater lit ~25% of lunar day; western part in permanent shadow
properties.ice_evidence: LCROSS ejecta water concentration 5.6 ± 2.9% by mass (Colaprete et al. 2010, as reported in wiki:Lunar water).
properties.hazards: permanent darkness; <100 K surfaces; crater walls

properties.name: Marius Hills pit (mare volcanic dome field)
properties.status_note: Candidate lava-tube skylight identified by SELENE and confirmed with LROC; representative subsurface-access environment, not a mission site.
properties.elevation_datum: Moon: height above 1737.4 km sphere; Mars: MOLA areoid
properties.dem_product: LRO LOLA global LDEM 118 m (USGS Astrogeology mosaic, Mar 2014)
properties.illumination: pit floor partly overhung (LROC Pits Atlas: Overhang=Y)
properties.hazards: ~40 m deep pit (LROC atlas); boulder-covered floor; overhangs
properties.mission_objectives: lava-tube / subsurface habitat scouting; radiation and thermal shelter

properties.name: Mare Tranquillitatis pit
properties.status_note: Mare pit with possible cave extension (Horvath et al. 2022); representative subsurface environment.
properties.elevation_datum: Moon: height above 1737.4 km sphere; Mars: MOLA areoid
properties.dem_product: LRO LOLA global LDEM 118 m (USGS Astrogeology mosaic, Mar 2014)
properties.illumination: pit floor partly in permanent shadow beneath overhang
properties.hazards: ~100 m deep pit (NASA 2022 release); vertical walls; illuminated floor >420 K peak (modeled)
properties.mission_objectives: lava-tube / subsurface habitat scouting; thermal-stable shelter

properties.name: Apollo 11 Tranquility Base (mare regolith plains)
properties.status_note: Verified 1969 crewed landing site (historic); not a base site.
properties.elevation_datum: Moon: height above 1737.4 km sphere; Mars: MOLA areoid
properties.dem_product: LRO LOLA global LDEM 118 m (USGS Astrogeology mosaic, Mar 2014)
properties.illumination: equatorial day/night cycle (~29.5 Earth days synodic)
properties.hazards: regolith dust; small craters and boulders
properties.mission_objectives: mare regolith handling; surface mobility on plains

properties.name: Jezero crater delta (Perseverance landing site)
properties.elevation_datum: Moon: height above 1737.4 km sphere; Mars: MOLA areoid
properties.dem_product: MGS MOLA global DEM 463 m (USGS Astrogeology mosaic)
properties.mission_objectives: astrobiology/biosignatures in lacustrine sediments; sample caching for return

properties.name: Gale crater (Curiosity Bradbury Landing)
properties.elevation_datum: Moon: height above 1737.4 km sphere; Mars: MOLA areoid
properties.dem_product: MGS MOLA global DEM 463 m (USGS Astrogeology mosaic)
properties.hazards: sharp rocks (wheel damage reported in mission literature, not quantified here); dunes
properties.mission_objectives: habitability of ancient lakes; stratigraphy of Aeolis Mons

properties.name: Elysium Planitia volcanic plains (InSight landing site)
properties.elevation_datum: Moon: height above 1737.4 km sphere; Mars: MOLA areoid
properties.dem_product: MGS MOLA global DEM 463 m (USGS Astrogeology mosaic)
properties.ice_evidence: Possible ash-covered water ice reported near 5°N 150°E (Mars Express, wiki:Elysium Planitia) - debated.
properties.hazards: low hazards; selected as smooth, flat plains
properties.mission_objectives: geophysics; safe landing on flat plains; habitat siting on low-slope terrain

properties.name: Vastitas Borealis periglacial plains (Phoenix landing site)
properties.elevation_datum: Moon: height above 1737.4 km sphere; Mars: MOLA areoid
properties.dem_product: MGS MOLA global DEM 463 m (USGS Astrogeology mosaic)
properties.mission_objectives: ice-soil boundary habitability; ISRU ground ice

properties.name: Planum Boreum north polar layered deposits
properties.status_note: Representative polar ice environment; no landing site.
properties.elevation_datum: Moon: height above 1737.4 km sphere; Mars: MOLA areoid
properties.dem_product: MGS MOLA global DEM 463 m (USGS Astrogeology mosaic)
properties.ice_evidence: Ice cap mostly water ice (~95%) with dust layers (wiki:Planum Boreum).
properties.hazards: scarps up to ~2 km; avalanches off scarps (HiRISE); polar night

properties.name: Arsia Mons flank cave skylights (lava tubes / basaltic shield)
properties.status_note: Seven putative cave entrances identified on Arsia flanks (Cushing et al. 2007 as summarised in wiki:Arsia Mons); some may be pits only.
properties.elevation_datum: Moon: height above 1737.4 km sphere; Mars: MOLA areoid
properties.dem_product: MGS MOLA global DEM 463 m (USGS Astrogeology mosaic)
properties.ice_evidence: Orographic water-ice cloud (atmospheric), not ground ice.
properties.hazards: high elevation, thin atmosphere for EDL; pit walls

properties.name: Arcadia Planitia mid-latitude ground ice plains
properties.status_note: Described as an area of interest for potential exploration because of near-surface excess ice; not a selected landing site.
properties.elevation_datum: Moon: height above 1737.4 km sphere; Mars: MOLA areoid
properties.dem_product: MGS MOLA global DEM 463 m (USGS Astrogeology mosaic)
properties.ice_evidence: Excess ice widespread in mid-latitudes, especially Arcadia Planitia (wiki).
properties.mission_objectives: ISRU ground ice for human missions; low-elevation EDL
